description_en: Uploads the private key corresponding to a CSR if the private key was not provided when the local CSR was uploaded
description_zh: 如果您在上传本地CSR时未传入CSR私钥，您可以通过该接口上传CSR对应的私钥
name: UpdateCsr

parameters.description_en: The unique ID of the CSR. The CsrId is generated when the CSR is uploaded. You can obtain this value by querying the CSR list. For more information, see [ListCsr](~~2709717~~).
parameters.description_zh: CSR唯一标识。上传CSR时会生成CsrId。您可以通过查询CSR列表获取该值，接口详情，请参见[ListCsr](~~2709717~~)。
parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the CSR. The CsrId is generated when the CSR is uploaded. You can obtain this value by querying the CSR list. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709717.html
parameters.help_zh: CSR唯一标识。上传CSR时会生成CsrId。您可以通过查询CSR列表获取该值，接口详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709717.html
parameters.name: csr_id

parameters.description_en: The private key content in PEM format.
parameters.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- MII.... -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The private key content in PEM format
parameters.name: key
